groups.title: Hero's Party
groups.def: The four-person party led by Himmel that defeated the Demon King, as shown in flashbacks.

groups.title: Frieren's Party
groups.def: Frieren's traveling party after Himmel's death, as shown in the anime.

groups.title: First-Class Mage Exam Candidates
groups.def: Characters shown taking the First-Class Mage Exam as candidates.

groups.title: Mage Exam Examiners
groups.def: Continental Magic Association mages shown personally administering a stage of the First-Class Mage Exam that Frieren and Fern take.

groups.title: Demons
groups.def: Demons who appear on screen (including in flashback) in the anime.

groups.title: Legends of the Past
groups.def: Figures whose stories are told as historical "Legends of the Past," met or referenced by Frieren's group.

groups.title: Warrior Class
groups.def: Characters whose class is Warrior (including former Warriors and demon Warriors).

groups.title: Names That Are German Verbs
groups.def: Characters whose name is also a German infinitive verb.

groups.title: Continental Magic Association
groups.def: Characters affiliated with the Continental Magic Association, the mage licensing body, as shown in the anime.

groups.title: Known By an Epithet
groups.def: Characters given an on-screen epithet in the form "[Name] the [Title]".
